comments.author: @BeautyLandScapeBD
comments.text: Norway's fjords are unreal — the cliffs, the blue water and the little villages between the mountains are so beautiful. This video makes me want to see Geirangerfjord and the Lofoten Islands in person. Thank you for this lovely guide.

comments.author: @dinarich1134
comments.text: I’m in Tampa, Florida, and watching this video has made me seriously consider moving to Norway. It’s hard to believe that people are just tools for the American government. Schools, work, and social life is nothing but a nightmare
